v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Supervised pilot: AWS backend selected, premium site acceptance unverified and owner/security defects open
v1.summary: Oct 29 production capture web :420 / worker :268 reports WEBSITE_BUILDER_BACKEND=aws. Stromation #331 new skill engine merged but default off; Fargate Chromium sandbox and unmerged #820/#833 form contract prevent a real skill-built site. No accepted post-fix premium AWS delivery or three handoffs. CSS/502 #779 merged but production rollout-probe proof unverified. Open #850/#853 expose auth/owner isolation defects; #831 site ownership 404; #862 staging Stripe TEST finds spent-credit refund-request bug.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Useful worker code merged; repeated real-provider five-worker outcomes unverified
v2.summary: Alex Lighthouse, Avery page watch and Richard enhancements merged mostly behind default-off switches. Open #827–#829 simulated employee outcome bench offers no implemented credit. Production capture has dashboard/recap enabled, but no verified five-worker real-provider cycles, delivered recaps or recurring independent outcomes.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.status: Broader platform work advances; premium delivery, security proof, SaaS/custom agents and economics remain incomplete
v3.summary: Skill-engine code is merged but unproven on live AWS; newly documented security/form/customer-flow defects offset code gains. Full supported SaaS, custom-agent delivery, 95–99% routine autonomy, margins and founder technical hours lack measured evidence.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.

v1Remaining: Connect skill-engine form contract and Fargate Chromium sandbox (#331/#820/#833), then independently accept one real AWS premium site with settled model costs.
Prove 3 premium sites through revisions, publication, export and ownership handoff.
Demonstrate unattended failure recovery with zero duplicate work or charges.
Merge and production-check auth/owner security, site-ownership and spent-credit fixes (#850/#853/#831/#862).
Verify CSS/502 mitigation (#779) during live rollouts, checkout dialogs, rollback and restore.
v2Remaining: Verify repeated real-provider outcomes for all five employees and delivered daily recaps.
Enable and test the essential standard integrations and recurring owner workflows.
Demonstrate safe autonomous recovery and operation without founder rescue.

promisesOverreach: Do not claim #331 skill engine or #779 CSS mitigation is successfully live without full cloud job/rollout proof.
Open #820/#831/#833/#850/#853/#862 fixes get no implemented credit.
Stripe TEST staging success is not evidence of a live paid-to-published site.
Open #827–#829 bench and merged disabled worker features are not real-provider results.
Do not claim 95–99% unattended workflow success, positive job margins or 1–2 Darius technical hours/week.
founderWorkloadTrend: Founder technical rescue remains unmeasured; owner approvals and specialist review do not count as founder rescue.
nextActions: First unblock Fargate browser and form contract; run one independently accepted end-to-end premium AWS website with settled costs.
Then prove three distinct paid-to-publication/export/ownership journeys with unattended recovery.
Before launch merge, stage and production-verify auth/owner permission, refund-credit, site ownership, CSS/502 and restore fixes.

assumptions: The website-builder asset/recovery defect is fixed and the merged repair release is deployed and repeatedly proven within roughly 30 days.
SelfOperate receives about 150–500 qualified prospects/visitors over 90 days.
Paid conversion is roughly 1–2% while the product remains supervised.
Supervised delivery capacity remains roughly 2–4 projects per month.
Roughly half to three-quarters of eligible delivered customers retain the $299/month ongoing SelfOperate service after any included period.
